set.body:
Outcome

Make every dense ScalaFIM image a zero-wrapper checked refinement of one image4s Sampled value backed by one Ravel NDArray.

Work

- Implement the precise volume, image-series, label, mask, component, and generic non-spatial-axis contracts chosen by the architecture gate.
- Remove the universal ScalaFimValues semantic witness and use image4s Continuous, Categorical, and Mask evidence.
- Retain the exact SampleSpace owner in core APIs and existentialize only at dynamic loading boundaries.
- Admit arbitrary immutable Ravel layouts as valid images; add an explicit whole-canonical capability for linear hot kernels.
- Make time selection, crop, flip, stride, and other exact views zero-copy.
- Replace copied spatial slices with an affine-honest singleton-D3 view or an explicitly modeled embedded-plane result.
- Make canonical series-to-(nVoxels,nTime) reshape zero-copy and make any fallback materialization explicit.

Acceptance

- Runtime identity proves one Sampled object and one NDArray storage owner per dense image.
- Semantic compile tests reject categorical or mask use in continuous interpolation.
- Whole canonical, cropped, flipped, strided, and time-selected cases have value and allocation proofs on JVM and Scala.js.
- Public constructors retain immutable Ravel values zero-copy and copy mutable external arrays only through explicitly named APIs.
- No separate dense NeuroVol, NeuroVec, NeuroSlice, component, or hyper-image storage class remains.
set.title: Rebuild dense volumes and series as semantic image4s Sampled refinements
